raw_text:
Meera Krishnan 
Digital Marketing Manager 
Kochi, Kerala   |   meera.krishnan@example.com   |   90720XXXXX 
PROFILE 
 
Marketing manager with 7 years of experience across digital campaigns, brand strategy, and content, including 2 
years leading a team of 4. Skilled at turning a limited budget into measurable growth, with a strong record of 
improving organic traffic and campaign ROI for consumer brands. 
AREAS OF EXPERTISE 
 
SEO / SEM   –   Google Ads & Analytics   –   Meta Ads Manager   –   HubSpot   –   Content strategy   –   
Marketing automation   –   Team management   –   Budget planning   –   Brand storytelling   –   Cross-functional 
coordination 
CAREER HISTORY 
 
Marketing Manager — Vantara Consumer Brands, Kochi 
Mar 2023 – Present 
– Lead a team of 4 across SEO, paid media, and content for a D2C skincare brand 
– Grew organic traffic by 60% over 12 months through a full SEO overhaul 
– Manage an annual digital ad budget of ₹45 lakh across Google and Meta 
– Launched an influencer partnership program that drove 15% of new customer acquisition 
Marketing Executive — Spectrum Digital Agency, Kochi 
Jul 2019 – Feb 2023 
– Ran paid campaigns for 10+ client accounts spanning retail, hospitality, and education 
– Improved average client campaign ROI by 25% through continuous A/B testing 
– Built monthly performance reports that became the agency's client-reporting template 
Marketing Associate — Spectrum Digital Agency, Kochi 
Aug 2017 – Jun 2019 
– Supported campaign setup and reporting for 5 client accounts 
– Wrote blog and social content for 3 hospitality clients 
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS 
 
– Grew a client's Instagram following from 8,000 to 65,000 in 14 months through organic content strategy 
– Recognized as 'Top Campaign Manager' at Spectrum Digital Agency, 2021 
ACADEMIC BACKGROUND 
 

MBA, Marketing — Kerala University (2015 – 2017), 7.9 CGPA 
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION 
 
Certifications: Google Ads Certification (2023); HubSpot Content Marketing Certification (2021) 
Languages: English (fluent), Malayalam (native) 
Additional Information: Guest lecturer on digital marketing basics for local BBA/MBA colleges (2022 – present)
